'''Eila''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. She was a [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]], involved in a plot with [[Kollan Xa]] and [[Ccalras Corporation]] to get [[Beeyon Nace]] to provide them with information from his post in the [[Spaceport Traffic Control/Legends|Mos Eisley Spaceport Control Tower]]. Eila pretended to fall in love with Nace, and then staged her own kidnapping in an effort to get him to work for Ccalras.<ref name="VI" />
